## **Recent Media Coverage**

[![award winner logo](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20500%20250'%2F%3E)](https://techround.co.uk/usa/24-ordway-labs/)

### **Ordway Ranked in Top 50 US Startups**

Ordway was selected as one of [TechRound’s winners](https://techround.co.uk/usa/announced-techrounds-us50-2026-winners-are/) in the publication’s first ever US50 competition.  A panel of independent judges selected companies based on their demonstrated use of AI to solve industry-specific problems.  Ordway [ranked #24](https://techround.co.uk/usa/24-ordway-labs/) on the list.

[View Winners](https://techround.co.uk/usa/24-ordway-labs/)

[![venture capital newsletter](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20500%20250'%2F%3E)](https://createsend.com/t/d-CF85E0EA4F10FD6C2540EF23F30FEDED?mod=venture-capital_more_article_pos3)

### **Ordway in Wall Street Journal**

Ordway’s recent funding round was [featured in the Wall Street Journal’s Venture Capital Newsletter](https://createsend.com/t/d-CF85E0EA4F10FD6C2540EF23F30FEDED?mod=venture-capital_more_article_pos3) along with stories about SpaceX IPO and a new potential funding round for an AI unicorn backed by Alibaba and Baidu.  Ordway raised $20M from Harbert Growth Capital and Western Alliance Bank.

[Read Newsletter](https://createsend.com/t/d-CF85E0EA4F10FD6C2540EF23F30FEDED?mod=venture-capital_more_article_pos3)

### **Fintech Growth Capital for AI**

Ordway’s recent $20M funding round to was featured in [CFODive](https://www.cfodive.com/press-release/20260810-ordway-secures-20m-in-growth-capital-to-accelerate-ai-roadmap/).  Ordway’s recurring revenue has doubled over the past two years, while the company has maintained profitability.  More enterprise deals with more complexity – multiple legal entities, multiple general ledgers, and multiple financial reporting jurisdictions – are driving larger deals in new customer acquisition.

[Read Article](https://www.cfodive.com/press-release/20260810-ordway-secures-20m-in-growth-capital-to-accelerate-ai-roadmap/)

### **MGI 360 Rating for Agile Billing**

[MGI 360 Ratings](https://mgiresearch.com/mgi-360-ratings/) help finance and IT executives make more informed purchasing decisions for new and existing technology suppliers which minimizes risks and saves time and money.  MGI recently updated [Ordway’s rating in Agile Billing](https://mgiresearch.com/mgi-360-rating/billing-ordway-labs-june-2026/) to 46 with a Neutral Analyst rating.

[Read Article](https://mgiresearch.com/mgi-360-rating/billing-ordway-labs-june-2026/)

This [Venture Burn article](https://ventureburn.com/ordway-secures-20m-funding/) covers Ordway’s plans to use the funds to double its research and development funding and broaden its AI roadmaps with new automation solutions including the release of AI-enhanced cash reconciliation that reconciles payments from any number of bank accounts with invoices.

[Read Article](https://ventureburn.com/ordway-secures-20m-funding/)

### **AI for Autonomous Finance and Cash Reconciliation**

In [this interview with Fintech Business Asia](https://fintechbusinessasia.com/interaction/1/3137/ordway-bets-on-ai-to-eliminate-reconciliation-bottlenecks-and-accelerate-autonomous-finance.html), Steve Keifer, VP Marketing and CMO at Ordway Labs, discusses how AI is transforming invoice-to-cash workflows, the safeguards required for enterprise adoption, opportunities across Asia-Pacific, and the company’s long-term vision for autonomous finance.

### **Ordway Raises $20M in Growth Capital from Harbert and Western Alliance**

[Finextra covers Ordway’s latest funding](https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/110589/ordway-secures-20-million-in-growth-capital-to-support-ai-roadmap) round $20M in additional equity and debt funding led by Harbert Growth Partners with debt participation from Western Alliance Bank’s Innovation Banking Group.  The investment positions Ordway to help finance teams manage a new generation of increasingly complex business models without adding more spreadsheets, manual processes, or operational overhead.

[Read Article](https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/110589/ordway-secures-20-million-in-growth-capital-to-support-ai-roadmap)

### **Ordway Launches AI Powered Cash Application for Modern Finance**

This [AI Journal article](https://aijourn.com/ordway-launches-ai-powered-payments-to-end-manual-reconciliation-for-modern-finance-teams/) discusses Ordway’s new AI-powered cash application technology that automatically matches incoming payments to outstanding invoices, regardless of source.  Built as an extension of Ordway’s order-to-revenue automation platform, Ordway Payments unifies billing and payments into a single, integrated application.

[Read Article](https://aijourn.com/ordway-launches-ai-powered-payments-to-end-manual-reconciliation-for-modern-finance-teams/)

### **Ordway Launches AI-Powered Payments and Cash Application**

[Credit Risk Monitor](https://info.creditriskmonitor.com/NewsStory.aspx?NewsId=65310489&AK=Nina) covers the launch of Ordway Payments, a comprehensive payments solution designed to eliminate the costly and time-consuming reconciliation challenges that burden finance teams.  By bundling billing, payments, reconciliation, and cash application into a single unified system, Ordway removes friction from the financial close process and frees teams to focus on strategic initiatives rather than on manual matching tasks.

[Read Article](https://info.creditriskmonitor.com/NewsStory.aspx?NewsId=65310489&AK=Nina)

### **How Payments Are Broken And What The Industry Still Needs To Get Right**

Payments aren’t failing because transactions don’t go through—they’re failing because finance teams are still stuck manually untangling fragmented systems after the money moves. This [Forbes article](https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbesbusinesscouncil/2026/05/22/how-payments-are-broken-and-what-the-industry-still-needs-to-get-right/) from Sameer Gulati breaks down why reconciliation remains one of the biggest hidden pain points in modern finance and what the industry must do to finally fix it.

[Read Article](https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbesbusinesscouncil/2026/05/22/how-payments-are-broken-and-what-the-industry-still-needs-to-get-right/)

[![Scaling Smarter Podcast interview with Sameer Gulati](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20500%20200'%2F%3E)](https://open.spotify.com/episode/4cx4WmX05wr4lengTgS3Cr)

### **Future of SaaS – Where AI Agents Meet Enterprise Software**

In this podcast [episode of Scaling Smarter](https://open.spotify.com/episode/4cx4WmX05wr4lengTgS3Cr), David Hirschfeld sits down with Sameer Gulati, CEO of Ordway Labs, to explore how AI is transforming revenue operations. From contract to cash, Sameer breaks down how automation is eliminating friction between sales and finance, and why that gap has held companies back for years.

[Read Article](https://open.spotify.com/episode/4cx4WmX05wr4lengTgS3Cr)

In this [Forbes article](https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbesbusinesscouncil/2025/12/30/self-driving-finance-how-far-can-we-really-go-in-2026/), Sameer Gulati discusses how far AI can go in 2026 towards automating routine finance tasks such as billing, revenue recognition, monthly close, and audit preparation.  Over the last few years, the phrase “self-driving finance” has moved from buzzword to boardroom agenda. Vendors promise AI-powered, fully autonomous back offices. Demos show dashboards updating in real time.
